summary: ADR-T0587: analyst READ-PDP honesty, closing the remainder after T-0607. (1) A minimal per-registry numeric aggregate (count/sum/avg/min/max over one auto-detected numeric field, generic via deriveFieldType — D-064, no hardcoded field name) is accumulated INSIDE the existing loadReadableRegistryDigest per-row loop, strictly AFTER isRecordReadable(...)===true — same predicate, same scan, no new SQL/PDP path. The pure accumulation logic lives in a new IO-free module src/core/visible-aggregate.ts. (2) buildDraftContext gains a zero-visibility branch: when the digest is known but the asker sees zero visible records everywhere (and no registry contributed an aggregate), the server deterministically instructs the LLM to answer with the new ASSISTANT_ANALYST_NO_VISIBLE_DATA_MESSAGE constant — framed as the asker's OWN zone of visibility, never a system-state claim, and identical whether the underlying data is genuinely empty or merely invisible to this asker (FR-3 anti-leak). (3) Regression tests lock the existing identity discipline (loadRegistryDigest always called with ctx.userSubject.subjectId, never agentSubject) and the existing per-row filter-order invariant. (4) Live-DB tests prove two/three real identities (owner full-visibility, narrow record-scoped grant, zero grant) get strictly-subset/refusal answers, both at the DAO level and through the REAL HTTP chat route (registerAssistantRoutes + setAnalystPorts wired to the real DAO — production shape, not a stub).

fix_summary.visible_aggregate_module: src/core/visible-aggregate.ts (new, pure/IO-free): initNumericAccumulators/accumulateNumeric/finalizeNumeric (chosen field-value accumulation, coercing via Number() and skipping non-finite/missing/object values without corrupting the running aggregate) + pickNumericFieldKeys(recordSchema, limit) which derives numeric field keys+labels generically from registry_def.record_schema.properties via the EXISTING field-type-dictionary.ts::deriveFieldType(prop)==='number' dictionary (NF-1: one resolver, not a second numeric-detection rule), capped at numericFieldLimit (default 5, NF-5 bounded).
fix_summary.registry_digest_dao: src/db/registry-digest-dao.ts: ReadableRegistryEntry gains an OPTIONAL numericAggregates field; RegistryDigestOptions gains an OPTIONAL numericFieldLimit (default 5). The SQL query for registries now also selects rd.record_schema (no new query, same SELECT). Inside the existing per-row scan loop, numeric fields are derived once per registry (pickNumericFieldKeys) and accumulateNumeric is called ONLY inside the branch where isRecordReadable(...)===true — the exact same branch that increments visibleCount/samples. No second scan, no new PDP path.
fix_summary.assistant_messages: src/core/assistant-messages.ts: new additive constant ASSISTANT_ANALYST_NO_VISIBLE_DATA_MESSAGE — 'В вашей зоне видимости данных по этому вопросу нет. Если данные должны быть вам доступны — обратитесь к администратору вашей организации, чтобы он выдал доступ.' Framed as the asker's own zone of visibility; never asserts 'данных в системе нет' (FR-5); identical wording whether the registry is globally empty or merely invisible to this asker (FR-3).
fix_summary.assistant_analyst_buildDraftContext: src/core/assistant-analyst.ts::buildDraftContext: the prior three-way branch (null / degraded / registries.length===0 / non-empty) is restructured so registries.length===0 AND (totalVisible===0 with no non-empty aggregate) BOTH fold into ONE honest zone-of-visibility refusal branch (a server-built instruction embedding ASSISTANT_ANALYST_NO_VISIBLE_DATA_MESSAGE verbatim, telling the LLM not to cite numbers or assert record existence/non-existence). The prior 'в доступных разделах пока нет записей — это достоверный факт' framing is RETIRED for the zero-visibility case (ADR-T0587 §2.2: that framing asserted a system-state fact true only when registries are GLOBALLY empty; when non-empty-but-invisible-to-this-asker it would have been a lie). The non-zero-visibility branch additionally renders numericAggregates per registry when present.

invariants_preserved.identity_fr1: runAnalyst still resolves loadRegistryDigest(ctx.tenantId, ctx.userSubject.subjectId) — never ctx.agentSubject.subjectId, never a hardcoded owner/service identity. Locked by a NEW regression test (src/core/__tests__/assistant-analyst.test.ts, FF-1/AC-1) asserting the exact identity passed, plus a second case proving a DIFFERENT userSubject changes which identity is used (no hardcode).
invariants_preserved.filter_order_fr2: The new aggregate is computed strictly inside the isRecordReadable===true branch of the EXISTING loop — verified at two levels: (a) src/core/__tests__/visible-aggregate.test.ts proves accumulateNumeric has literally no visibility into rows the caller never passes to it (simulating the PDP filter); (b) ci/checks/db/registry-digest.test.ts (live Postgres) proves a record-scoped grant narrower than the tenant's default-open grant yields a numericAggregates.sum that reflects ONLY the visible record's value, never the invisible sibling's.
invariants_preserved.no_second_pdp_nf1: Zero new SQL statements, zero new grant/ancestry resolution calls — the SAME getGrantsForSubject + loadTenantOrgAncestry + makeResourceAncestryOracle + isRecordReadable call that already existed in loadReadableRegistryDigest is reused unchanged; only the accumulation logic riding along the existing per-row loop is new.

ReadableRegistryEntry/RegistryDigestOptions gain only OPTIONAL fields; loadReadableRegistryDigest's positional signature is byte-identical.
